name: 2D_26_intersectionTarget
definition: Creates an intersection target for 2D input ensuring 26 connectivity as a line array. It consists of 3 lines connecting opposite face centers of the voxel.
summary: 2D_26_intersectionTarget is a voxelization primitive using diagonal lines through the voxel center to ensure 26-connectivity and prevent topological holes, unlike 6-connected targets that use face centers.
